digest.component_or_area: tickets store fsck and repository maintenance
propositions: The tickets store contains 561 pre-existing fsck diagnostics: 550 SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, 10 ORPHAN_EVENT (all AUTO-RECOVER LINK type), and 1 intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit record that must be retained.
The scoped repair tooling (Gerrit 1391) enables selective remediation via rebar fsck --repair --only=stale-channel with resumable batching, refusing tickets with mixed faults to ensure safety.
Orphan events span 9 mixed tickets and 1 orphan-only ticket; all 10 LINK orphans are automatically recoverable without human triage.

The live quiet-window repair executed successfully: orphan repair batch committed+pushed, then three stale-channel batches (limit=200 each) committed+pushed, converging to exactly 4 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records with zero repairable diagnostics remaining.
Pre-repair bundle and rollback artifacts were verified to restore the exact pre-window tip and diagnostic manifest identically across independent restores.
